newsitem.title: USA: American Radio Q3 revs soar to $52.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: American Radio Q3 revs soar to $52.5 mln.

text.p: American Radio Systems said net revenues totalled $52.5 million for the third quarter against $25.1 million for the same period last year.

The company said in a statement net revenues totalled $113.6 million for the nine-month period, compared to $69.6 million during the same period in 1995. American Radio, which owns 46 FM and 23 AM stations across the United States, said the results were due to improved radio station operations as well as station acquisitions.

It said broadcast cash flow totalled $17.1 million during the third quarter against $9.2 million last year. During the last nine months, it totalled $35.4 million against $21.0 million the previous year.
